purpose: Label every non-HIT click with a miss_cause and a stable feature vector so agents learn interop failures vs geometry errors over time. Rule classifier (RULE_V1) first; features are ML-ready.

recommended_practice.PEER_HUD_COLLISION: WAITING_FOR_AGENT; claim exclusive_live_hud_surface before insert; do not rewrite hitbox from peer fight
recommended_practice.OVERLAY_CLEAR_WIPE: Withhold PEER_LEASED_HUD_SURFACE on overlay-clear; re-observe before next click
recommended_practice.WRONG_CONTROL: Do not update intended target coords; record observed_control_id
recommended_practice.STALE_SURFACE: Re-open surface in same burst or abort; phone auto-close is not a hitbox miss
recommended_practice.ZOOM_INSUFFICIENT: OBJECT_PICK_IDENTIFY: Z/wheel zoom-in then capture before world click
recommended_practice.HITBOX_DRIFT: Score via click_error_eval; Escape-cancel; only HIT may attest coords
recommended_practice.LOT_PUNCH_THROUGH: ESCAPE_CANCEL via CANCEL_HOLD; never continue recipe into lot
recommended_practice.UNKNOWN: Quarantine; require operator/host label before learning update

classifier.note: Deterministic priority rules. Future ML must consume the same feature_schema and may not silently drop PEER_HUD_COLLISION / OVERLAY_CLEAR_WIPE.
